title: Following Pointer
description: Swaps the cursor for an arrow and a name tag that trail the pointer inside a region.

a11y.motion: The arrow and tag track the pointer 1:1 with no spring, and appear and hide without a scale or fade.
a11y.screenReader: The arrow and tag are aria-hidden; the wrapped content is read and focused as normal.

examples.title: Blog grid
examples.description: A grid of post cards where hovering shows a "Read post" tag.
